notes: This contract traces the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 interaction transportation-type control slice. Interaction attributes start from the FDD type, a publisher's accepted change affects only its future ordinary and regional sends, confirmation is the commit boundary, and queries report the publisher override or the FDD type when the target federate does not publish. Only HLAreliable and HLAbestEffort are supported. Directed interactions, custom transport, save/restore, remote transport, protected review, catalog evidence, JUnit evidence, and conformance remain outside this contract.
